# DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/{username}

Delete a user account, optionally purging all owned data

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-100`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| purge | query | boolean | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Not admin
- **404** — User not found
- **422** — User is org, self-delete, owns repos/orgs/packages, or is last admin

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.DeleteUser | controller | Check user is not org; Check not self-delete; Delegate to service |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | user_service.DeleteUser | service | Check last admin; If purge: disable user, delete repos, remove from orgs, delete packages; In transaction: verify no repos/orgs/packages remain, delete user data, delete unlinked attachments; Rewrite authorized_keys; Remove user directory and avatar from storage |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | deleteUser (internal) | service | Decrement watch/star/follow counters; Delete all user-related beans; Delete comments if purge or user is new; Remove user from branch protections; Delete public keys and GPG keys; Clear assignees; Remove external login links; Delete auth tokens; Delete user record |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot delete a user that is an organization | validation | ctx.ContextUser.IsOrganization() |
| Admin cannot delete themselves | authorization | ctx.ContextUser.ID == ctx.Doer.ID |
| Non-purge delete requires user to have no repos, orgs, or packages | business_logic | count > 0 for repos/orgs/packages |
| Purge mode disables user immediately before deletion | business_logic | purge == true |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| User owns repositories | 422 | validationError | False |
| User belongs to organizations | 422 | validationError | False |
| User owns packages | 422 | validationError | False |

### Error Paths

- **User is organization** → admin.DeleteUser → 422
- **Self-delete attempt** → admin.DeleteUser → 422
- **User owns repos (non-purge)** → admin.DeleteUser → 422
- **User has orgs (non-purge)** → admin.DeleteUser → 422
- **User owns packages (non-purge)** → admin.DeleteUser → 422
- **Last admin user** → admin.DeleteUser → 422

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | n_plus_1_queries | Branch protection cleanup iterates ALL protected branches in batches, checking each for user ID | Add DB-level filtering or index on serialized user IDs in branch protections |
| medium | n_plus_1_queries | Comment deletion in purge mode iterates comments in batches of 50, deleting one by one | Batch delete comments instead of one-by-one |
| medium | synchronous_blocking | Purge mode deletes all repos synchronously before user deletion | Consider async purge with background job |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] async**: Move purge operations to background job — *Impact: Prevent long-running HTTP requests for users with many repos*
- **[P2] query_optimization**: Batch comment deletion instead of one-by-one — *Impact: Reduce DB round-trips for users with many comments*

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | medium | Purge mode performs multi-step operations (disable user, delete repos, delete orgs) outside transaction |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ Purge: disable user → delete repos → remove from orgs → delete user (each step outside main transaction)

**Cascading failure risk:** Partial purge could leave orphaned data if process crashes mid-way

**Graceful degradation:** User is disabled first, preventing further actions even if purge fails
